Jess (Account Exec): Nice — p99 for non-streaming /chat at 760ms is higher than last week, correct?
Mike (SRE): Yep — +18% p99 week-over-week on non-streaming chat. Streaming p99 improved slightly after the kernel bump.
Ana (CS): Any error rate impact tied to the p99 bump?
Mike (SRE): 5xxs are stable at 0.12% across routes. However, aborted streaming sessions increased 0.6% — looks like client-side timeouts during long streams.
LatencyBot: ALERT: Spike detected on /chat non-streaming p99 at 1769456802 — 780ms (threshold 700ms).
Jess (Account Exec): Customer reported a couple of long-tail responses yesterday during demo — could be the same.
Ana (CS): For renewal call, can we propose mitigations? Pref list: 1) Suggest client timeout bump + streaming when possible. 2) Enable prefix cache for repeated prompts. 3) Consider temporary Dedicated capacity during peak demos.
Mike (SRE): Agreed. Quick numbers: caching could cut non-streaming p95 by ~25% for that account's pattern. Reserved capacity buys predictable p99; estimate reduction to ~400–500ms under commit.
Jess (Account Exec): I'll frame as: short-term client change + enable streaming + our ops proposal for Dedicated trial. Risk level: medium-low. They'll want cost impact.
Ana (CS): @Jess please ask for the demo timestamps so we can correlate logs. @Mike can you attach a short grafana panel screenshot to the ticket after this thread?
Mike (SRE): Will do — I'll open a ticket and drop the panel link.
Ana (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll update the renewal notes and follow up with action items before EOD. :thumbsup:
